apps.name: Manotu
apps.localizedDescription: This is an early iPhone preview; on-device branding may differ from the current website. Open-source community navigation for Malaysia. Favourites and planned drives stay on your phone. This preview uses file backups; iCloud and Google Drive sign-in are unavailable in the sideload build. Requires AltStore Classic or Sideloadly. Free accounts need a refresh every seven days.

versions.localizedDescription: Public preview for AltStore Classic. File backup/restore available. iCloud and Google Drive sign-in disabled in this re-signed build.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Gimano uses the camera so you can add photos of places and reviews.
privacy.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Gimano keeps using your location while you navigate with the screen off, so voice guidance and traffic reports keep working.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Gimano uses your location to show where you are, find places near you and guide you turn by turn.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Gimano can save photos you choose to your library.
